title.zh: CFTC proposals aimed at separating prediction markets from casino gambling
title.en: CFTC proposals aimed at separating prediction markets from casino gambling

current_state.zh: The CFTC proposed two rules that would classify event contracts as federal 'swaps' while excluding casino gambling, escalating its jurisdictional battle with states suing prediction-market operators like Kalshi and Polymarket.
